name: Body Double
description: A listening test for Tier A0 of acoustic rendering: should the hand-designed body presets be replaced by rendered cavities? In every sketch, odd bars play the body preset and even bars play the cavity proposed to replace it, on the same source sound. One click marks a preset bar, two clicks a rendered bar. Rate each sketch by how well the rendered version stands in for the preset (5 = at least as good, 1 = clearly worse), and note what differs: brightness, ring, air resonance, loudness. The first rendered bars may use the fallback body while the render finishes, so give each test a few loops. The cavity settings are estimates from the box, tube and air-hole formulas; that is what is being tested.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Guitar · Spruce Box
sketches.description: body("guitar") against a 45 cm spruce box with a sound hole, whose air mode should sit near the guitar's 100 Hz.

sketches.name: Violin · Maple Box
sketches.description: body("violin") against a small, narrow maple box with f-hole-sized openings, under a bowed saw.

sketches.name: Box · Wooden Box
sketches.description: body("box") against a closed wooden box sized so its first mode lands near 180 Hz, on drums and a pluck.

sketches.name: Tube · Open Tube
sketches.description: body("tube"), with modes at 220, 440, 660 Hz, against a 78 cm open tube, whose half-wave series should start near 220 Hz.

sketches.name: Can · Metal Cylinder
sketches.description: body("can") against a small open-topped metal cylinder, on claps, rims and hats where the metallic ring is easy to hear.

sketches.name: Phone · Plastic Box
sketches.description: body("phone") against a tiny plastic box, on a sung line, the case where speech intelligibility matters most.

sketches.name: Radio · Speaker Box
sketches.description: body("radio") against a 30 cm wooden box with a large opening, like an old cabinet radio, on saw chords.

sketches.name: Megaphone · Metal Tube
sketches.description: body("megaphone") against a short metal tube, on a shouted line. There is no cone shape yet, so this tests how far a tube gets.

sketches.name: Size Ladder
sketches.description: Does cavsize scale like bodysize? Guitar at bodysize 0.5, 1 and 2 against the spruce box at 22, 45 and 90 cm, two bars per size. Each new size may play the fallback until its render is ready.

sketches.name: Material Ladder
sketches.description: The guitar preset held fixed against the same box in spruce, maple, wood and plastic, two bars each. Note which material comes closest.

sketches.name: Half Wet
sketches.description: bodymix(.5) against cavmix(.5): with half the dry sound mixed back in, the two should sit at the same level and keep the attack equally sharp.

sketches.name: Cavity Wins
sketches.description: A precedence check: one track sets both body and cavity, which should warn (W-ARG-UNSUPPORTED on body) and sound like the cavity. A reference track plays the body alone on even bars.
